verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions maintained integrations with RAG or agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. The items that come closest cover the MCP server and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI). Those belong to separate stories and are not framework integrations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations
